name: Zul'Farrak: both kinds of Shallow Grave despawn after they are opened
contract: Issue #4338: opening a Shallow Grave in Zul'Farrak summons its zombies (10247) and the grave despawns two seconds
later, so it cannot be opened again. #9104 fixed Shallow Grave 128403; Shallow Grave 128308 had a despawn row
without a target and stayed. Both now vanish after they are opened. The graves in Zul'Farrak lie close together, so the test summons one on its own.

steps.label: CONTROL: a Shallow Grave 128308 lies at the digger's feet
